AnimeThemes for Silo, Linux amd64 and arm64.

Maps seasons through AniBridge v3 and Anime-Lists, selects exact AnimeThemes audio, and publishes it into validated season directories. Includes preview, persistent mapping snapshots, protected file publication and Autoscan discovery checks. Start with preview enabled and follow the included configuration guide.

Install through the Crowquillx plugin catalog or upload the matching raw binary. Tarballs include the manifest, configuration example and license notices. Verify downloads with `checksums.txt`.
